bio: The small village of Saussignac (some 20km from Bergerac) is home to this charming stone building that is typical of the region and located right next to the château. Beyond the wooden terrace, the restaurant interior, which features exposed stone walls, hardwood floors and white-painted beams, is brought up to date by a handful of more contemporary decorative touches. In the kitchen, a blend of styles and influences goes into creating colourful, innovative dishes made with seasonal ingredients: confit turkey leg, mashed potatoes, mushrooms and a corn and bacon sauce....
